verdict.rationale: Vendor docs reference building automation that connects tools to Jira workflows and using Rovo AI to create custom rules (reminders, auto-moving work) which aligns with trigger-and-action automation, but the evidence pack lacks any independent/hands-on confirmation of Jira's no-code automation rule builder specifically, and community commentary never mentions the automation engine at all. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the automation rule builder, concrete examples of trigger/condition/action configuration, and detail beyond marketing copy.
